purpose: Classify user-provided files, links, screenshots and text into CRM import previews.
mapping_strategy: Classify input type and likely CRM entity.
Normalize phones, emails, dates, prices, currencies and locations.
Search for duplicates using entity search_order.
Produce an internal preview with mapped fields, missing fields, duplicate risk and proposed action.
Execute safe create, update, import, classify, enrich and media-link actions without confirmation when confidence and permissions are sufficient.
Ask for explicit confirmation only before delete, bulk delete, revoking access, mass external campaigns, payments or irreversible actions.

expected_property_structure: folder name may contain development, unit, tower, location or property title
images and videos are media assets
PDFs may contain price, floor plans, amenities and payment plans
spreadsheets may contain inventory, prices or availability
subfolders may separate renders, planos, amenidades, contratos, precios
google_drive_public_folder_strategy.guardrail: If the public link cannot be read by backend, ask the user to upload files or share a public folder/file link.

recommended_mapping: precios y disponibilidad -> inventory, price list and availability source
renders -> Media Hub gallery linked to property
PDF -> OCR/text extraction for units, prices, availability, amenities and payment terms
